offer.title: Aura 400 Waterless Scent Diffuser
offer.positioning: A compact wall-or-desktop scent system for intentional room atmosphere without a water tank.
offer.seoDescription: Create a consistent home atmosphere with a compact 400 ml waterless scent diffuser designed for wall or desktop placement.
offer.bodyHtml:
Build a more intentional room atmosphere without refilling a water tank. Aura 400 is a compact waterless scent diffuser designed for wall mounting or desktop placement.

Why it belongs in your space

  • 400 ml fragrance capacity
  • Wall-mounted or freestanding placement
  • Remote-control operation
  • US plug option
  • Designed for homes, garages, hospitality spaces and studios

What to know

This is the black US-plug configuration. Fragrance oil is sold separately. Estimated supplier transit is 8–9 days before domestic handling; the final delivery estimate is shown at checkout.

Frequently asked questions

Does it use water?

No. This model is designed as a waterless fragrance-oil diffuser.

Can it be wall mounted?

Yes. The supplier specifies both wall and flat-surface installation.

Is fragrance included?

No fragrance is promised with this offer. Choose a compatible oil separately.
